name: Adversity
source:
"A harsh instructor who believes the best lessons in life are the most painful.

Humorless and foul-tempered, he has no mercy for those who don't subscribe to his brutal philosophy. He aims to inflict the most amount of trauma he can on his pupils.

Occupation: Gravemaster
Attributes: Cruel. Cunning. Ruthless."
- Itch.io Marketing, 'Information Module - Adversity'
